setting.template: T_p(xi,xj,xk) = p(xi,xj) XOR p(xi,xk) XOR p(xj,xk)
setting.no_vocabulary_enlargement: The 16-code vocabulary is NOT enlarged. #1649 forbids enlarging formula size or operators over an unchanged vocabulary as a route to promotion.

computations.what: decide affineness for all 16 codes by ANF degree, and check the count is exactly 8
exhaustively determine every sufficient primitive set, over ALL subsets of the 16 codes
reduce to minimal bases by inclusion
compute indispensable primitives as the intersection of all minimal bases
compute the minimum under the registered complexity order and whether it is UNIQUE or a tie

gates.statement: After granting Post's lattice and standard ANF decidability, does the minimal-basis and indispensability result state anything the donor does not already supply?
gates.operationalisation: The result survives donor subtraction ONLY IF it yields a certification a clone-theoretic reader lacks — specifically a UNIQUE minimum under the registered complexity order together with a nonempty indispensable set, so that the expansion is provably THE minimal admissible one rather than merely A sufficient one. Sufficiency alone is donor-owned and does not count.

gates.statement: The minimum under the registered order is unique.
At least one indispensable primitive exists.
Any comparison is made under identical information; no arm receives held-out tasks the other lacks. The committed selector already states that selection receives no held-out tasks.

controls.statement: The ANF test must return exactly 8 affine codes of 16. A different count means the decision procedure is wrong and nothing downstream may be read.
majority3 must NOT be realisable using only affine primitives under the template; otherwise the whole expansion premise is vacuous.
A planted primitive known NOT to realise the target must be reported insufficient by the SAME test used for real primitives.
The recomputed admissible set must agree with the committed runner's own selection logic on the frozen origin. Disagreement means this packet has re-modelled the object.

terminals.licenses: A bounded statement that the frozen expansion is certifiably THE minimal admissible one under the registered complexity order, which clone theory alone does not supply.

conditions: the result reduces to sufficiency facts already supplied by Post's lattice and ANF decidability
terminals.action: Stop promotion. Return ORION-20 to the bounded formal lane per #1649. Do NOT start another rescue cycle and do NOT enlarge the vocabulary.

conditions: the minimum under the registered order is a tie, or no indispensable primitive exists
terminals.reading: A tie is acceptable as a RESULT per #1649 but it defeats the certification claim, because the expansion is then only A minimal choice, not THE minimal one.

falsifiability_self_check.why_predicted: The setting is 16 codes with a fixed template and a classical target. Sufficiency is plainly donor-owned. Only certified minimality under the registered order is a candidate delta, and it is a narrow one.
falsifiability_self_check.note: The most likely outcome of this package is that it stops its own promotion. That is what #1649's stop rule is for, and predicting it in advance is what keeps the donor gate honest.

stop_rule: Outcomes are read once. On T2 or T3 the promotion stops and ORION-20 returns to the bounded submission lane without another rescue attempt.
